The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1953–1954''' was contested by 56 teams participating in four divisions. It would be the last season on an amateur basis. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of each division of the [[Netherlands]]. [[FC Eindhoven]] won this year's championship by beating [[VV DOS|DOS]], [[PSV Eindhoven]] and [[AFC DWS|DWS]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse A:'''
*Moving in from Division B: [[Be Quick 1887]], [[Blauw-Wit Amsterdam]], [[AFC DWS|DWS]], [[USV Elinkwijk|Elinkwijk]], [[HFC Haarlem]] and [[Telstar (football club)|Stormvogels]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Oosterparkers]]
'''Eerste Klasse B:'''
*Moving in from Division A: [[VV DOS|DOS]], [[HFC EDO]], [[FC Groningen|GVAV Rapiditas]], [[VV Sneek Wit Zwart|Sneek Wit Zwart]], [[Volewijckers|De Volewijckers]] and [[Telstar (football club)|VSV]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[vv Rigtersbleek|Rigtersbleek]]
'''Eerste Klasse C:'''
*Moving in from Division D: [[Roda JC|Bleijerheide]], [[NAC Breda|NAC]], [[PSV Eindhoven]] and [[XerxesDZB|Xerxes]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[VVH Heerlen]]
'''Eerste Klasse D:'''
*Moving in from Division C: [[SBV Excelsior]], [[Juliana (football club)|Juliana]], [[MVV Maastricht]] and [[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[EBOH (football club)|EBOH]]
